TABLE.NAME: auth_shibboleth_link
TABLE.COMMENT: Link shibboleth users to moodle users

FIELD.NAME: idp
FIELD.COMMENT: The identity provider id. On MySQL/MariaDB this column is forced to utf8mb4_bin via db/install.php resp. db/upgrade.php (2026090900), because classes/lib.php compares it case-sensitively. XMLDB has no collation attribute, so this cannot be expressed here.

FIELD.NAME: idpusername
FIELD.COMMENT: The username from the identity provider id. See idp field comment regarding utf8mb4_bin.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Wer hat den Link zuletzt geändert: 0=user (default), 1=automatch, 2=manager

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: userid der zuletzt ändernden Person; 0 = System/Cron
